title: Native CTest batches should inherit the selected build tree
body: The queued native CPU CTest command first failed before running CTest: tools/run-native-cpu-suite.bat defaulted to C:\vixen-native\vxtools1\tools\..\build\ninja and reported that the tree was not configured. I recovered by exporting VIXEN_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR=/mnt/c/vixen-native/vxtools1/build/ninja-release and rerunning the same queued vixen-native command; test_spatial_reuse_history_mirror then passed 1/1. The native launcher already knows the selected vixen-ninja-release tree, so it should derive and forward that path to every native CTest batch, or fail early with the exact configured-tree path. Tier luna: this is a normal cross-platform runner contract with a focused witness; effort S.

title: Native CTest phases should register their Windows process root
body: During the queued native CPU witness, --status showed the job had winnative=1 and grant-cpus=6 but tk-cores=0.4+?, jobuse-win=unregistered, and jobuse-win-source=unregistered while tools/vixen-native.sh had started the Windows CTest phase. The native Release build registered its root for cancellation, but the CTest phase wrapper did not publish a root for Windows CPU attribution. Make the shared native phase runner call the same Register-NativeRunRoot contract before launching ctest.exe and clean it up after exit, so the queue's promised per-job Windows CPU field is populated and cancellation can name the exact tree. Tier luna: this is a normal runner/queue integration change with a focused witness; effort M.
